purpose: Improve the discoverability and focus behavior of individual physical component selections.
behaviors: Selected physical mesh receives an independent gold-colored back-face silhouette and crisp edge lines; no unselected architectural mesh changes.
Camera and orbit target move together to center the selected part; existing zoom/angle are preserved.
A second click on the same 3D mesh or its matching index row clears the selection and restores the prior camera and target.
An anchored screen-space ring and label locate small or occluded parts, including elements within the roofed cella.
The marker is pointer-transparent, and both marker and temporary outline are removed on deselection.
The existing Study and Realistic material toggle preserves the selected part and outline, without shifting its focus.
Reset returns to the standard exterior home camera without restoring an older selection viewpoint.

validation.renderedReview: Inspected the Chromium image showing a distinct gold ring and readable component label on an interior Ionic capital beyond the roof, with component inspector still visible.

bounds: This affects visitor selection overlays and camera navigation only, not the 536-instance architectural ontology or archaeological accuracy classification.
rights: Original local rendering and CSS; no external icon, image, or material asset.
